blockingFindings.description: Direct inspection of the V168 arms-up and arm-cross previews shows the sleeve tubes remain extended sideways from the shoulders instead of following the raised or crossed arms; the clothing no longer forms an integrated sleeve silhouette.
Direct inspection of the V168 crouch, sit, and prone previews shows the jacket collar and torso displaced from the visible body, including a large separated jacket section in prone.
Across the V168 five-view and neutral previews, the overskirt remains heavily crumpled with raised rear sections; crouch, sit, and prone show projecting strips and separated lavender trim.

outOfScope: VRChat Build & Test and runtime inspection
